page.overview:
Who is Skymate?

Skymate was mentioned (but not seen) in one issue in 1991: #118.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Skymate was released in the 1991 series of A Real American Hero toys. Despite coming with a vehicle, the figure was carded, as the Air Commando gliders were sold that way. ---- Appearance: pink helmet; brown hair and mustache; dark green short-sleeved shirt with yellow straps; green gloves; black pants with yellow belt and green boots
